description: Canonical JSON vectors (docs/audit.md). Every value in `inputs` must canonicalize to exactly `expected`. Shared with other language SDKs.
notes: Key order is UTF-16 code unit order (JavaScript's default string sort, RFC 8785 JCS), NOT Unicode code point order: a supplementary-plane key such as an emoji (a surrogate pair, 0xD800-0xDFFF) sorts before a BMP key above U+D7FF such as U+FB01, although its code point is larger. Sort keys as UTF-16 code unit sequences in every language (Python: sorted(keys, key=lambda k: k.encode('utf-16-be'))).
Integer-like keys are compared as strings, never numerically.
Numbers are serialized in JavaScript's shortest round-trip form (JSON.stringify); -0 is 0.
Non-ASCII characters are emitted as UTF-8, not \u escapes; only quotes, backslashes and control characters are escaped.

cases.name: nested objects and arrays: keys sorted at every depth, array order kept
strings: non-ASCII kept as UTF-8, quotes, backslashes and control characters escaped
integer-like keys are sorted lexicographically, not numerically
keys compare by UTF-16 code unit: uppercase, then underscore, then lowercase
keys compare by UTF-16 code unit, not code point: an emoji key (surrogate pair) sorts before a BMP key above U+D7FF
empty containers and every scalar type
